evidence.observation: The isolation suite passed and the full-scale run recorded zero cross-tenant disclosures.
The full-scale run recorded zero post-revocation disclosures.
The final verifier replays the versioned audit holdout and requires zero private-fragment leakage and zero schema violations.
Deletion evidence passed; the restore workflow requires offline deletion-ledger replay before service.
The run recorded zero acknowledged-write loss, but 214 operations remained after the five-minute recovery window.
The live branch drill proved upgrade and downgrade with zero data loss.

limitations: The 100 GiB source profile was represented by document metadata; source object bytes were not materialized.
Multi-process API and restarted-worker RSS growth was not measured reliably.
This review does not replace provider configuration review, dependency scanning, penetration testing, or an operator-approved production restore.

production_recommendation.reason: Hard-safety evidence passed, but the declared throughput, latency, index-freshness, recovery, object-materialization, and memory-observation gates did not all pass.
